Mantine Dropzone (drag & drop upload)

Source: R/Dropzone.R
Dropzone.Rd

When files are dropped (or selected via click), input[[inputId]] receives list(count = <number of files>, files = <one element per file, with name/size/type>) — the file content is not uploaded over this channel. If you need to actually upload the files, pair this with a regular shiny::fileInput() (you can hide it via CSS and trigger it from a click on the Dropzone). Always use input[[inputId]]$count for the file count (not length(input[[inputId]])): a JSON array with a single object gets "flattened" by R differently than one with several objects, making length() on $files alone unreliable.

Like Dropzone(), but instead of a fixed drop area, listens for drops anywhere on the page while active is TRUE — typically toggled by a button (updateMantineProps(session, mantineId, active = TRUE/FALSE)). Reports the same {count, files} metadata to input[[inputId]] as Dropzone().

Usage

Dropzone(inputId, ..., accept = NULL, maxSize = NULL)

DropzoneFullScreen(inputId, ..., active = FALSE, accept = NULL, maxSize = NULL)

DropzoneAccept(...)

DropzoneReject(...)

DropzoneIdle(...)

Arguments

inputId

Id of the Shiny input receiving file metadata.

...

Children (typically DropzoneAccept()/DropzoneReject()/ DropzoneIdle() with icons + text) and other props forwarded to Dropzone (multiple, loading, ...). See https://mantine.dev/x/dropzone/.

accept

Vector of accepted MIME types (e.g. c("application/pdf")); NULL to accept everything.

maxSize

Maximum size per file in bytes (NULL for no limit).

active

Whether the full-screen dropzone is currently listening for drops anywhere in the browser window. Toggle from the server with updateMantineProps() (needs a mantineId).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
DropzoneFullScreen(
  inputId = "files", mantineId = "full_dz", active = FALSE,
  Text("Drop files anywhere on the page")
)
# server:
observeEvent(input$activate_btn, {
  updateMantineProps(session, "full_dz", active = TRUE)
})
} # }
